verdict.rationale: YPOG is a law firm offering legal, tax and notary advisory services, so running a product headlessly or in CI is a category error for this kind of product. Its mentions of legal tech and the software-supported ySolutions unit describe internal tooling behind a managed service, not a runnable product with a headless or CI mode. The probes also found no API or OpenAPI surface (all 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
